Verdict: needs_changes. The implementer summary correctly declares `Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)`, and structured `target_context.commands_run` is empty, so I found no forbidden command shapes.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Dashboard “safe mutation commands” are not safe for project paths containing spaces. Evidence: `dashboard_projection()` builds `--project {project_arg}` without shell quoting at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/role_assignment.py:269` and `:282-284`; a scope path like `/tmp/my repo` produces `dontpanic roles set implementer <executor> --project /tmp/my repo`, which would parse incorrectly if copied/run. Recommendation: shell-quote path-based project arguments, or emit argv arrays alongside display strings and test paths with spaces.
